dashboard.title: UCCA — Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Consolidated results by facility, practitioner, criterion and quarter (submitted or approved audits only)
dashboard.empty: No submitted or approved audits for the selected filters.

rules.title: Evaluation rules
rules.score: Score = Yes ÷ Applicable × 100. N/A answers are excluded from the denominator. With no applicable criteria there is no score or outcome.
rules.na: Every N/A requires a short, traceable reason.
rules.finding: If the outcome is not Compliant and there is at least one No, the key finding is mandatory; a corrective action (owner and due date) is recommended.
rules.workflow: Workflow: Draft → Submitted → Approved. An approved audit is immutable.
rules.dashboard: The dashboard only counts submitted or approved audits; % per criterion = Yes ÷ (Yes + No).
